title: Set up vLLM macOS Apple Silicon CPU dev env at github/vllm

result.limitations: macOS CPU remains experimental upstream (no prebuilt wheels, FP32/FP16 only, Model Runner V2 skipped because Triton is absent, V1 runner used). Environment workarounds that scripts must keep: run smoke code under an `if __name__ == "__main__":` guard (macOS spawn), lower CPU reservation (`gpu_memory_utilization=0.2`; the 0.92 default exceeds the 17.86 GiB free), and set HF_HOME/VLLM_CACHE_ROOT inside the workspace because the DSH sandbox cannot write ~/.cache. The `code` CLI exited 0 but its IPC never opened a window, so the folder was opened with `open -a "Visual Studio Code"`; verification comes from VS Code's own workspace/Python logs, not a GUI screenshot (host GUI automation was deliberately not used).
